Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"max_concurrent\":1}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var urls = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(new string[] { "https://example.com/success1", "https://example.com/fail", "https://example.com/success2" });
await foreach (var chunk in CrawlbergConverter.BatchCrawlStreamAsync(engine, urls))
{
    Console.WriteLine(chunk);
}
```
